name: EPIC 220276308
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.4 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,498 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.98 solar masses and 9.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,732 K at its surface.
